name: Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 on maximum residue levels
summary: Sets maximum residue levels for pesticides in food and feed of plant and animal origin; consignments exceeding an MRL may not be placed on the EU market.

name: Regulation (EU) 2020/18 non-renewal of chlorpyrifos
summary: Withdraws approval of chlorpyrifos as an active substance; all authorisations were revoked and the MRL reduced to the limit of determination.

name: Regulation (EU) 2018/848 on organic production
summary: Defines which inputs may be used in certified organic production and the labelling rules for organic products placed on the EU market.

name: Plant Protection Products Regulation
summary: Governs authorisation, labelling and permitted use of plant protection products in Turkey, including pre-harvest intervals and banned active substances.

name: Organic Farming Law No. 5262
summary: Establishes the national framework for organic production, certification and inspection in Turkey.
